legend.as_owner.record: Always the same shape; has_history is false when no rewarded bounty of this owner's has been merged (all counts 0). merged: rewarded bounties GitHub records as merged (GitHub's fact). recorded_paid: the owner says they paid (the owner's word). confirmed_received: the payee says the money arrived (the solver's word). from_solvers: how many different solvers gave those confirmations; one solver can confirm several. owed_now: merged and not recorded paid; oldest_owed_days: the longest of those, in days (the board sets no deadline). says_not_received: recorded paid, but the payee says it has not arrived. median_days_to_record_paid: typical days from merge to the owner's record. Merges where the payee is the poster, or where GitHub lists the merged pull request's author as OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR of the repository (its public author_association), are not counted. A bounty with more than one merged pull request counts once as merged and owed until the owner records whom they paid.
legend.not_counted: Merged rewarded bounties left out of the record because the payee was the poster or GitHub lists them as OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR of the repository.
legend.accepts_payment_by: Methods this person chose to show everyone. Methods marked "only an owner who owes me" are counted, never listed: only the owner of a bounty that owes this person sees them, on that bounty's page.
